INETD.description: Whether to run the server via inetd (1) or as a daemon (0). Only used by the init script. Commented out by default.

NICENESS.description: Nice priority for the nrpe server. Only used by the init script. Commented out by default.

NRPE_OPTS.description: Extra cmdline parameters to pass to the nrpe daemon. Commented out by default, with -n disabling SSL.
